what: The small square dots (three stacked) left of the button label run to the button’s right end on hover (.5s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), each dot .017s later so the tail seems to drag). While running they pinch to .3× and expand again at the end (.125s + .017s sequence), and the label shifts left by the dot width (1.625rem) .15s later. The background plate swells to 1.035×1.065, and on press it squashes to .955×.954 then returns in .45s along a springy wobble curve (linear() easing). On touch screens, pressing only pinches the dots to .3×

options.--fx-run: Distance the text moves aside after the dot runs (css variable), default 1.625rem

note: The dot and background layers are made by fx.js (just place one label). The background is --kf-ink, text and dots are --kf-bg — if a light version is needed, change the colors of .fx-drb__bg and .fx-drb__dot in the consuming css

from.where: shared.js·shared.css .zh-btn (Request Demo button in the header, hero and CTA — original color tennis button, three dots in --index·--parent-index order)
